text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno Dictus fought hard, but fell short. 
It was Tokai Teio who claimed victory with 
a breathtaking run. Everyone rejoices over 
her miraculous comeback.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio expressed her gratitude. Ikuno 
Dictus warmly replied with a gentle, 
"Welcome back."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though victory had eluded her, a look of 
quiet satisfaction rested on Ikuno 
Dictus's face.
